title: Wiem i Powiem
summary: An emergency rebuild of an existing website.
seoDescription: An emergency rebuild of the Wiem i Powiem website from scratch: content, blog and contact form moved to a new framework, with a refined mobile layout.
portfolioImageAlt: Wiem i Powiem homepage presenting its whistleblowing report handling service.

blocks.text:
The original Wiem i Powiem design was created by an external agency. The resulting website did not meet the Wiem i Powiem team’s expectations, so they approached Latarnik for help.

Using the existing site and the external agency’s visual design as a starting point, I rebuilt the Wiem i Powiem website from scratch. The existing content, blog articles and contact form were migrated to a new framework.

I also refined the layout so the website looks appealing on both mobile and desktop devices.
